category_name_en: Geography: The World Is Full of Surprises

category_name_en: Geography: The World Is Full of Surprises

category_name_en: Geography: The World Is Full of Surprises

category_name_en: Geography: Cities Shaped by Their Setting
clue_en: Which European capital grew from Buda and Pest on opposite banks of the Danube?
clue_et: Milline Euroopa pealinn kujunes Doonau vastaskallastel asunud Budast ja Pestist?
explanation_en: Buda and Pest were unified with Óbuda in 1873 to form Budapest on both sides of the Danube.
explanation_et: Buda ja Pest ühendati 1873. aastal Óbudaga ning nii tekkis mõlemal pool Doonaud asuv Budapest.

category_name_en: Geography: Cities Shaped by Their Setting
clue_en: Which Brazilian city curves around Guanabara Bay beneath Sugarloaf Mountain?
clue_et: Milline Brasiilia linn kaardub Guanabara lahe ümber Suhkrupeamäe all?
explanation_en: Rio de Janeiro developed around Guanabara Bay between steep granite peaks and the Atlantic.
explanation_et: Rio de Janeiro kujunes Guanabara lahe ümber järskude graniittippude ja Atlandi ookeani vahel.

category_name_en: Geography: Cities Shaped by Their Setting
clue_en: Which North American capital is slowly sinking because much of it was built on a former lakebed?
clue_et: Milline Põhja-Ameerika pealinn vajub aeglaselt, sest suur osa sellest ehitati endisele järvepõhjale?
explanation_en: Mexico City was built over the drained bed of Lake Texcoco, and groundwater extraction has contributed to subsidence.
explanation_et: México rajati kuivendatud Texcoco järve põhjale ning põhjavee ammutamine on aidanud kaasa linna vajumisele.

category_name_en: Geography: Cities Shaped by Their Setting
clue_en: Which Bolivian seat of government fills a deep Andean valley beneath Mount Illimani?
clue_et: Milline Boliivia valitsuse asukoht täidab sügavat Andide orgu Illimani mäe all?
explanation_en: La Paz spreads through a steep valley on the Altiplano’s eastern edge beneath Illimani.
explanation_et: La Paz laiub järsus orus Altiplano idaserval Illimani mäe all.

category_name_en: Geography: Clues Hidden in a Map
clue_en: What box on a map explains the meaning of its colours and symbols?
clue_et: Milline kaardi osa selgitab selle värvide ja leppemärkide tähendust?
explanation_en: A map legend, also called a map key, links symbols and colours to the features they represent.
explanation_et: Kaardilegend ehk leppemärkide seletus seob sümbolid ja värvid nende kujutatud nähtustega.

category_name_en: Geography: Clues Hidden in a Map
clue_en: Which imaginary line divides Earth into northern and southern hemispheres?
clue_et: Milline kujuteldav joon jagab Maa põhja- ja lõunapoolkeraks?
explanation_en: The Equator circles Earth midway between the geographic poles.
explanation_et: Ekvaator kulgeb ümber Maa geograafiliste pooluste vahelisel keskjoonel.

category_name_en: Geography: Clues Hidden in a Map
clue_en: What map feature explains how a distance on paper relates to the real distance on the ground?
clue_et: Milline kaardi osa näitab, kuidas paberil mõõdetud vahemaa vastab tegelikule vahemaale maastikul?
explanation_en: A map scale expresses the ratio between a measured map distance and its real-world equivalent.
explanation_et: Kaardi mõõtkava väljendab kaardil mõõdetud vahemaa ja tegeliku vahemaa suhet.

category_name_en: Geography: Clues Hidden in a Map
clue_en: What line joins places of equal height on a topographic map?
clue_et: Milline joon ühendab topograafilisel kaardil sama kõrgusega kohti?
explanation_en: Closely spaced contour lines indicate a steeper slope than widely spaced lines.
explanation_et: Tihedalt paiknevad samakõrgusjooned näitavad järsemat nõlva kui hõredad jooned.

category_name_en: Geography: Clues Hidden in a Map
clue_en: Which reference meridian passes through Greenwich and divides eastern from western longitude?
clue_et: Milline Greenwichi läbiv võrdlusmeridiaan eraldab ida- ja läänepikkusi?
explanation_en: The Greenwich prime meridian is the conventional origin for measuring longitude.
explanation_et: Greenwichi algmeridiaan on geograafilise pikkuse mõõtmise kokkuleppeline lähtejoon.

clue_en: Which desert of towering dunes follows the Atlantic coast of Namibia?
clue_et: Milline kõrgete luidetega kõrb kulgeb piki Namiibia Atlandi rannikut?
explanation_en: The Namib is a coastal desert whose dunes meet the Atlantic in Namibia.
explanation_et: Namiib on rannikukõrb, mille luited ulatuvad Namiibias Atlandi ookeanini.

clue_en: Name the cold desert shared mainly by Mongolia and northern China.
clue_et: Nimeta külm kõrb, mis asub peamiselt Mongoolias ja Põhja-Hiinas.
explanation_en: The Gobi is a large rain-shadow desert spanning parts of Mongolia and China.
explanation_et: Gobi on suur vihmavarjukõrb, mis ulatub Mongoolia ja Hiina aladele.

clue_en: Northern Chile is home to which famously dry desert?
clue_et: Milline erakordselt kuiv kõrb asub Tšiili põhjaosas?
explanation_en: The Atacama occupies a plateau along the Pacific coast of northern Chile.
explanation_et: Atacama asub platool Tšiili põhjaosa Vaikse ookeani rannikul.

clue_en: Botswana lies at the heart of which sandy southern African desert?
clue_et: Millise liivase Lõuna-Aafrika kõrbe keskmes asub Botswana?
explanation_en: The Kalahari extends across Botswana and into Namibia and South Africa.
explanation_et: Kalahari ulatub Botswanast Namiibiasse ja Lõuna-Aafrika Vabariiki.

clue_en: What desert covers much of the peninsula that includes Saudi Arabia?
clue_et: Milline kõrb katab suure osa poolsaarest, kus asub Saudi Araabia?
explanation_en: The Arabian Desert occupies most of the Arabian Peninsula.
explanation_et: Araabia kõrb hõlmab suuremat osa Araabia poolsaarest.

clue_en: Which volcano is famous for burying the Roman city of Pompeii?
clue_et: Milline vulkaan on tuntud Rooma-aegse Pompei linna matmise poolest?
explanation_en: Vesuvius erupted beside the Bay of Naples and buried Pompeii in volcanic material.
explanation_et: Napoli lahe ääres pursanud Vesuuvi mattis Pompei vulkaanilise materjali alla.

clue_en: Sicily is dominated by which active volcano?
clue_et: Milline aktiivne vulkaan kõrgub Sitsiilia saarel?
explanation_en: Etna rises on the east coast of the Italian island of Sicily.
explanation_et: Etna asub Itaalia Sitsiilia saare idarannikul.

clue_en: What symmetrical volcanic peak is a national symbol of Japan?
clue_et: Milline sümmeetriline vulkaanitipp on Jaapani rahvussümbol?
explanation_en: Fuji is a stratovolcano on Honshu and one of Japan's best-known landmarks.
explanation_et: Fuji on Honshū saarel asuv kihtvulkaan ja üks Jaapani tuntumaid vaatamisväärsusi.

clue_en: Which Icelandic volcano became widely known when its ash disrupted European flights?
clue_et: Milline Islandi vulkaan sai laialt tuntuks, kui selle tuhk häiris Euroopa lennuliiklust?
explanation_en: An eruption beneath Eyjafjallajökull's ice cap produced an ash cloud that disrupted aviation.
explanation_et: Eyjafjallajökulli jääkatte all toimunud purse tekitas lennuliiklust häirinud tuhapilve.

clue_en: Hawaii's enormous Mauna Loa is what broad, gently sloping type of volcano?
clue_et: Mis tüüpi lai ja laugjate nõlvadega vulkaan on Hawaii hiiglaslik Mauna Loa?
explanation_en: Fluid basaltic lava built Mauna Loa into the broad profile typical of a shield volcano.
explanation_et: Voolav basaltlaava kujundas Mauna Loale kilpvulkaanile iseloomuliku laia profiili.

clue_en: Old Faithful geyser is protected in which American national park?
clue_et: Millises Ameerika rahvuspargis on kaitstud Old Faithfuli geiser?
explanation_en: Yellowstone contains the Old Faithful geyser and extensive geothermal landscapes.
explanation_et: Yellowstone'is asuvad Old Faithfuli geiser ja ulatuslikud geotermaalsed maastikud.

clue_en: The great wildebeest migration crosses which Tanzanian national park?
clue_et: Millist Tansaania rahvusparki läbib suur gnuude ränne?
explanation_en: Large herds migrate seasonally across the Serengeti ecosystem in Tanzania.
explanation_et: Suured loomakarjad rändavad hooajaliselt läbi Tansaania Serengeti ökosüsteemi.

clue_en: Lake Louise lies in which national park in the Canadian Rockies?
clue_et: Millises Kanada Kaljumäestiku rahvuspargis asub Lake Louise?
explanation_en: Banff protects mountain scenery and lakes including Lake Louise in Alberta.
explanation_et: Banffi rahvuspark kaitseb Alberta mägimaastikke ja järvi, sealhulgas Lake Louise'i.

clue_en: Visitors seek lions, elephants, and rhinos in which major South African national park?
clue_et: Millises suures Lõuna-Aafrika rahvuspargis otsitakse lõvisid, elevante ja ninasarvikuid?
explanation_en: Kruger protects extensive savanna habitat and many of Africa's best-known large mammals.
explanation_et: Krugeri rahvuspark kaitseb ulatuslikku savanni ja paljusid Aafrika tuntud suurimetajaid.

clue_en: Which park on Estonia's north coast was the country's first national park?
clue_et: Milline Eesti põhjaranniku park oli riigi esimene rahvuspark?
explanation_en: Lahemaa was established on Estonia's north coast to protect coastal, forest, and bog landscapes.
explanation_et: Lahemaa loodi Eesti põhjarannikule ranniku-, metsa- ja soomaastike kaitseks.

clue_en: Which country is Portugal's only land neighbour?
clue_et: Milline riik on Portugali ainus maismaanaaber?

explanation_et: Portugal jagab Pürenee poolsaart ja oma ainsat maismaapiiri Hispaaniaga.

clue_en: Name the country directly south of Canada across their long shared border.
clue_et: Nimeta riik, mis asub Kanadast lõunas nende pika ühise piiri taga.

explanation_et: Kanadal ja Ameerika Ühendriikidel on ühine piir nii mandril kui ka Alaska kõrval.

clue_en: Which Baltic country borders Estonia to the south?
clue_et: Milline Balti riik piirneb Eestiga lõunas?
explanation_en: Latvia lies immediately south of Estonia on the eastern Baltic coast.
explanation_et: Läti asub Eestist vahetult lõunas Läänemere idarannikul.

clue_en: Beyond the Himalayas, which country borders Nepal to the north?
clue_et: Milline riik piirneb Nepaliga põhjas teisel pool Himaalajat?
explanation_en: Nepal's northern frontier follows the Himalayas along the border with China.
explanation_et: Nepali põhjapiir kulgeb Himaalajas mööda Hiina piiri.

clue_en: Which large country forms much of Bolivia's northern and eastern border?

explanation_et: Brasiilia piirneb Boliiviaga ulatuslikult selle põhja- ja idaküljel.

clue_en: Which Estonian island is home to Kuressaare and the Kaali crater field?
clue_et: Millisel Eesti saarel asuvad Kuressaare ja Kaali kraatriväli?
explanation_en: Saaremaa lies off Estonia's west coast and includes both Kuressaare and Kaali.
explanation_et: Saaremaa asub Eesti lääneranniku lähedal ning seal paiknevad nii Kuressaare kui ka Kaali.

clue_en: What arm of the Baltic Sea separates northern Estonia from southern Finland?

explanation_en: The Gulf of Finland extends eastward between Estonia and Finland toward Saint Petersburg.
explanation_et: Soome laht ulatub Eesti ja Soome vahel ida poole Peterburi suunas.

clue_en: Which Swedish island in the Baltic Sea has Visby as its main town?

explanation_en: Visby is the principal town on the Swedish island of Gotland.
explanation_et: Visby on Rootsi Ojamaa saare peamine linn.

clue_en: Which river flows through Riga before reaching the Baltic Sea?
clue_et: Milline jõgi voolab läbi Riia enne Läänemerre suubumist?
explanation_en: The Daugava crosses Latvia and reaches the Gulf of Riga at the capital.
explanation_et: Daugava läbib Lätit ja suubub pealinna juures Liivi lahte.

clue_en: The Swedish-speaking Åland Islands are an autonomous part of which country?
clue_et: Millise riigi autonoomne osa on rootsikeelne Ahvenamaa?
explanation_en: Åland is a self-governing, demilitarised archipelago belonging to Finland.
explanation_et: Ahvenamaa on Soomele kuuluv omavalitsuslik ja demilitariseeritud saarestik.

clue_en: Which narrow strait connects the Mediterranean Sea with the Atlantic Ocean?
clue_et: Milline kitsas väin ühendab Vahemerd Atlandi ookeaniga?
explanation_en: The Strait of Gibraltar is the natural sea passage between the Atlantic and Mediterranean.
explanation_et: Gibraltari väin on looduslik mereühendus Atlandi ookeani ja Vahemere vahel.

clue_en: Which Italian island sits near the toe of the country's boot-shaped peninsula?
clue_et: Milline Itaalia saar asub saapakujulise poolsaare varba lähedal?
explanation_en: Sicily lies just across the Strait of Messina from mainland Italy.
explanation_et: Sitsiilia asub Mandri-Itaaliast teisel pool Messina väina.

clue_en: The ancient palace of Knossos stands on which Greek island in the Mediterranean?
clue_et: Millisel Vahemeres asuval Kreeka saarel paikneb muistne Knossose palee?
explanation_en: Crete is a Greek island in the Mediterranean and the location of the Minoan palace complex at Knossos.
explanation_et: Kreeta on Kreekale kuuluv Vahemere saar, kus asub Knossose minoiline paleekompleks.

clue_en: What sea lies between Italy and the Balkan Peninsula?
clue_et: Milline meri asub Itaalia ja Balkani poolsaare vahel?
explanation_en: The Adriatic is the northern arm of the Mediterranean between Italy and the Balkans.
explanation_et: Aadria meri on Vahemere põhjaosa Itaalia ja Balkani vahel.

clue_en: Nicosia is the capital of which island country in the eastern Mediterranean?
clue_et: Millise Vahemere idaosa saareriigi pealinn on Nikosia?
explanation_en: Cyprus is an island country in the eastern Mediterranean with Nicosia as its capital.
explanation_et: Küpros on Vahemere idaosa saareriik, mille pealinn on Nikosia.

clue_en: What is the capital of Thailand?
clue_et: Mis on Tai pealinn?
explanation_en: Bangkok is Thailand's capital and its main urban centre.
explanation_et: Bangkok on Tai pealinn ja riigi peamine linnakeskus.

clue_en: Manila is the capital of which Southeast Asian island country?
clue_et: Millise Kagu-Aasia saareriigi pealinn on Manila?
explanation_en: Manila is the national capital of the Philippines on the island of Luzon.
explanation_et: Manila on Luzoni saarel asuv Filipiinide pealinn.

clue_en: Which archipelago nation includes Java, Sumatra, and much of Borneo?
clue_et: Millise saareriigi koosseisu kuuluvad Jaava, Sumatra ja suur osa Borneost?
explanation_en: Indonesia is an archipelagic state whose major islands include Java and Sumatra.
explanation_et: Indoneesia on saareriik, mille suuremate saarte hulka kuuluvad Jaava ja Sumatra.

clue_en: In which country would you visit the temple complex of Angkor Wat?
clue_et: Millises riigis saab külastada Angkor Wati templikompleksi?
explanation_en: Angkor Wat stands near Siem Reap in Cambodia.
explanation_et: Angkor Wat asub Kambodžas Siem Reapi lähedal.

clue_en: The Mekong forms a vast, fertile delta in the south of which country?
clue_et: Millise riigi lõunaosas moodustab Mekong ulatusliku viljaka delta?
explanation_en: The Mekong Delta spreads across southern Vietnam before the river reaches the sea.
explanation_et: Mekongi delta laiub Lõuna-Vietnamis enne jõe merre suubumist.

clue_en: Which neoclassical gate topped by a four-horse chariot is a symbol of Berlin?
clue_et: Milline neljahobuserakendiga kroonitud klassitsistlik värav on Berliini sümbol?
explanation_en: The Brandenburg Gate stood beside the Berlin Wall and later became a symbol of German unity.
explanation_et: Brandenburgi värav seisis Berliini müüri kõrval ning sellest sai hiljem Saksamaa ühtsuse sümbol.

clue_en: Which palace and fortress complex overlooks Granada in southern Spain?
clue_et: Milline palee- ja kindluskompleks kõrgub Lõuna-Hispaanias Granada kohal?
explanation_en: The Alhambra preserves richly decorated palaces built by Granada's Nasrid rulers.
explanation_et: Alhambras on säilinud Granada Nasriidide valitsejate rikkalikult kaunistatud paleed.

clue_en: Antoni Gaudí designed which still-unfinished basilica in Barcelona?
clue_et: Millise siiani lõpetamata Barcelona basiilika projekteeris Antoni Gaudí?
accepted_variants_en: Basilica of the Sagrada Familia;Holy Family
explanation_en: Gaudí devoted much of his career to Barcelona's Sagrada Família basilica.
explanation_et: Gaudí pühendas suure osa oma karjäärist Barcelona Sagrada Família basiilikale.

clue_en: At which famous Roman fountain do visitors traditionally toss a coin over their shoulder?
clue_et: Millises kuulsas Rooma purskkaevus viskavad külastajad traditsiooni kohaselt mündi üle õla?
explanation_en: Visitors traditionally throw coins into the Trevi Fountain in Rome in the hope of returning to the city.
explanation_et: Külastajad viskavad Rooma Trevi purskkaevu traditsiooniliselt münte lootuses linna naasta.

clue_en: Which Brussels landmark enlarges an iron crystal into nine connected metal spheres?
clue_et: Milline Brüsseli vaatamisväärsus suurendab rauakristalli üheksaks ühendatud metallkeraks?
explanation_en: The Atomium was built for the 1958 Brussels World’s Fair and represents a greatly enlarged iron unit cell.
explanation_et: Atomium ehitati 1958. aasta Brüsseli maailmanäituseks ning kujutab tugevalt suurendatud raua kristallivõret.

clue_en: Which vast waterfall system lies on the border between Argentina and Brazil?
clue_et: Milline tohutu jugade süsteem asub Argentina ja Brasiilia piiril?
explanation_en: The Iguazú River forms hundreds of cascades where Argentina meets Brazil.
explanation_et: Iguazú jõgi moodustab Argentina ja Brasiilia piiril sadu jugasid.

clue_en: Which vast coral reef system lies off Queensland, Australia?
clue_et: Milline ulatuslik korallrahude süsteem asub Austraalia Queenslandi ranniku lähedal?
explanation_en: The Great Barrier Reef is a coral reef system off Australia's northeast coast.
explanation_et: Suur Vallrahu on Austraalia kirderanniku lähedal asuv korallrahude süsteem.

clue_en: What glowing sky display is often seen near the poles at night?
clue_et: Millist helendavat taevanähtust näeb sageli öösiti polaaraladel?
explanation_en: Charged particles interacting with the upper atmosphere create auroral light.
explanation_et: Laetud osakeste vastasmõju kõrgatmosfääriga tekitab virmaliste valguse.

clue_en: Which major waterfall lies on the Zambezi between Zambia and Zimbabwe?
clue_et: Milline suur juga asub Sambesi jõel Sambia ja Zimbabwe piiril?
explanation_en: Victoria Falls spans the Zambezi River on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe.
explanation_et: Victoria juga ulatub üle Sambesi jõe Sambia ja Zimbabwe piiril.

clue_en: Northern Ireland's coast features which natural site of interlocking basalt columns?
clue_et: Milline üksteisega liituvatest basaltsammastest looduspaik asub Põhja-Iirimaa rannikul?
explanation_en: Cooling lava fractured into the distinctive columns of the Giant's Causeway.
explanation_et: Jahtuv laava lõhenes Hiiglaste teele iseloomulikeks sammasteks.

clue_en: Which city on the River Tagus is the capital of Portugal?
clue_et: Milline Tejo jõe ääres asuv linn on Portugali pealinn?
explanation_en: Lisbon is Portugal's capital and stands near the mouth of the Tagus.
explanation_et: Lissabon on Portugali pealinn ning asub Tejo jõe suudme lähedal.

clue_en: Name the capital of Bulgaria.
clue_et: Nimeta Bulgaaria pealinn.

clue_en: Spain's royal palace and central government are in what capital?
clue_et: Millises pealinnas asuvad Hispaania kuningapalee ja keskvalitsus?
explanation_en: Madrid is the capital and political centre of Spain.
explanation_et: Madrid on Hispaania pealinn ja poliitiline keskus.

clue_en: The Charles Bridge crosses the Vltava in which national capital?
clue_et: Millises riigi pealinnas ületab Karli sild Vltava jõge?
explanation_en: Prague, the capital of Czechia, is built along the Vltava River.
explanation_et: Tšehhi pealinn Praha asub Vltava jõe ääres.

clue_en: What is the capital of Slovenia?
clue_et: Mis on Sloveenia pealinn?
explanation_en: Ljubljana is Slovenia's capital and main urban centre.
explanation_et: Ljubljana on Sloveenia pealinn ja peamine linnakeskus.

clue_en: Which city is the capital of Vietnam?
clue_et: Milline linn on Vietnami pealinn?
explanation_en: Hanoi is Vietnam's capital and lies beside the Red River in the north of the country.
explanation_et: Hanoi on Vietnami pealinn ning asub riigi põhjaosas Punase jõe ääres.

clue_en: The Forbidden City stands in which Chinese capital?
clue_et: Millises Hiina pealinnas asub Keelatud linn?
explanation_en: Beijing is China's capital and the location of the Forbidden City.
explanation_et: Peking on Hiina pealinn ning seal asub Keelatud linn.

clue_en: Name the capital of India, part of the wider Delhi metropolis.
clue_et: Nimeta India pealinn, mis kuulub suuremasse Delhi linnastusse.

clue_en: Which capital on the Han River is the political centre of South Korea?

explanation_en: Seoul is South Korea's capital and lies on the Han River.
explanation_et: Soul on Lõuna-Korea pealinn ja asub Hani jõe ääres.

clue_en: What is Mongolia's capital?
clue_et: Mis on Mongoolia pealinn?
explanation_en: Ulaanbaatar is Mongolia's capital and main city.
explanation_et: Ulaanbaatar on Mongoolia pealinn ja peamine linn.

clue_en: Which city on the Nile is Egypt's capital?
clue_et: Milline Niiluse-äärne linn on Egiptuse pealinn?
explanation_en: Cairo is Egypt's capital and lies beside the Nile.

clue_en: Name the capital of Kenya.
clue_et: Nimeta Keenia pealinn.

explanation_et: Nairobi on Keenia pealinn ja riigi peamine linn.

clue_en: The African Union has its headquarters in which Ethiopian capital?
clue_et: Millises Etioopia pealinnas asub Aafrika Liidu peakorter?

clue_en: What coastal city is the capital of Ghana?

clue_et: Milline sisemaalinn on Namiibia pealinn?

clue_en: Which Ontario city is Canada's national capital?
clue_et: Milline Ontario linn on Kanada pealinn?
explanation_en: Ottawa is Canada's capital and stands on the Ottawa River in Ontario.
explanation_et: Ottawa on Kanada pealinn ning asub Ontarios Ottawa jõe ääres.

clue_en: Name Brazil's purpose-built inland capital.

clue_en: The Plaza de Mayo is in which Argentine capital?

explanation_en: Santiago is Chile's capital in the country's central valley beside the Andes.
